The '''Bowl of Glass''' was an active [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. The caldera situated amid the canyons of the [[Frostfall]], the Bowl was harvested for its geothermal power using ancient techniques passed down from the first settlers of the planet.<ref name="NoP" />
